label: Non-sport / entertainment (Garbage Pail Kids, Marvel, Star Wars Topps, and similar 2.5×3.5 issues)
size_source: Modern licensed non-sport cards share the standard sports footprint 2.5×3.5 in (63.5×88.9 mm). Size class already stated in ALL_CARDS_SPEC.md. Modern sports/non-sport standard: https://baseball.cards/guides/baseball-card-size-and-dimensions/ (updated 30 Sep 2026). Confirm GPK / Marvel / Star Wars subsets that are mini, sticker, acetate or oversized before using this guide.
back_cues: brand/set-specific entertainment backs (not a single cue; use brand + typography)
grader_notes: CGC (11 Jul 2023) opened all non-sports including Garbage Pail Kids, Mars Attacks, Wacky Packages, Star Trek, from 1879 to today, within its size/thickness caps. TAG (23 Sep 2026) lists Marvel, DC, Garbage Pail Kids, Star Wars, Disney among accepted licensed brands, 1989–present, 2.5×3.5, ≤50pt, no relics. BGS: sports, gaming, and non-sports / Star Wars. ARS is TCG-title-based and is not a general non-sport grader.
